todo.summary: TODO(seal): this stub is replaced at seal (registration_block5.md sections 11 and 12) by the inventory of the commit H_claim. The filled file is committed in the seal commit, the child of H_claim, because a file cannot name the commit that contains it. So this stub is the file's state at H_claim itself, and no digest is written here.
todo.fails_closed: With files null and no SHA-256 values, the executed-code collector (joulewise/flags/collect.py) raises and emits code.identity_unmeasured, and the harvest (joulewise/b5/harvest.py) compares against an empty map and emits code.executed_differs_from_sealed and pack.identity_unmeasured. Every window is therefore not claim-usable until this file is filled. That is intended.
